summary: Xenetic Biosciences filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a Share Exchange Agreement to acquire all issued share capital of Swiss-based Santersus AG in a stock-for-stock reorganization under IRC Section 368(a). Consideration is Xenetic common shares at an Exchange Ratio per Santersus share, with outstanding Santersus options assumed and adjusted. Post-closing, Santersus holders are expected to own approximately 85% of Xenetic on a fully diluted basis assuming Net Cash of $0, making this a reverse-merger-style control transfer; Xenetic's existing holders retain about 15%. Watch for the definitive ratio, Nasdaq listing mechanics, and shareholder approvals.
